When using something like ""ip maddr add ..."" to add another unicast mac

column2: the mac address comes into the set_rx_mode handler

column1: in the multicast list whether it is a unicast or multicast address.
This was confusing the code when it was trying to search for addresses
that needed to be deleted from the VSI
column2: because it was looking for the

column1: VSI unicast address in the netdev unicast list.  The result was that a
new unicast address would get added to the VSI list and then immediately

column2: and would never actually make it down into the hardware.

column1: This patch removes the separation from unicast and multicast in the search
for filters to be deleted.  It also simplifies the logic a little with a
jump to the bottom of the loop when an address is found.  Now it doesn't
matter which netdev list the address is hiding in
